sentence: This project studies how histamine affects mucus secretion in the salivary glands and tests the effects of probiotics that produce histamine.
This project brings together and analyzes long-read genome sequencing and structural variation data across a consortium and improves a data analysis platform.
This project provides genomic assays and data analysis methods to support cancer research, using genome sequencing and microarray analysis.
This project studies how changes in occupations across the population have shaped mortality trends and stalled life expectancy in the United States.
This project tries to find out whether blocking an enzyme protects heart cells and stops scar tissue that makes the heart pump less effectively.
This project builds models of how genes interact with each other and with the environment to shape complex traits.
This project builds an airway stent with artificial cilia that can remove excess mucus from the airway.
This project provides statistical and computational support for cancer studies, including study design and data analysis.
This project studies how state cannabis laws have changed opioid receipt and pain outcomes in people with cancer.
This project tries to find out whether mucus plugs in the airways block airflow in severe asthma and whether treating them helps.
This project uses an imaging method to test whether brains of people with schizophrenia have an abnormal number of connection points between neurons.
This project develops thin coatings for cochlear implants to reduce trauma and scarring in the cochlea and help the implants carry complex auditory signals.
This project studies how long-lived cardiac proteins in the cytoskeleton keep oocytes healthy as they age.
This project uses forward genetics to find genes that control retinal development, retinal immune surveillance and early diabetic retinopathy.
This project studies how the airway lining develops in health and asthma and how early infection with a virus changes that development.
This project tests whether a live attenuated vaccine put into the bladder can clear bacteria that persist there after infection.
This project tests whether genetically engineered bacteria on the skin can make protease inhibitors to treat atopic dermatitis in a protease-driven model.
This project uses genetics to find genes that control follicular helper T cells, an immune cell type that helps make antibodies.
This project develops a low-profile brace with force sensors that helps children with scoliosis apply the proper force and track wear time.
